items.summary: ## Summary `qbee-agent` contains a Zip Slip vulnerability in `app/utils/tar.go`. The tar extractor checks whether an entry remains inside the destination directory with: ```go strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, destdirClean) ``` This does not enforce a path separator boundary. If the destination directory is `/tmp/.../context`, a tar entry such as `../context-outside/payload.txt` cleans to `/tmp/.../context-outside/payload.txt` and still passes the prefix check. qbee-agent then creates the outside di

items.title: Silverstripe Framework: RCE via i18nTextCollectorTask writer parameter
items.summary: ### Impact The writer option of the i18nTextCollectorTask dev task was passed to the injector without validation. A crafted dev task URL could create arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and run code on the server. Because the dev task did not ask for confirmation, an administrator could be tricked into running it by following a link. On a site in dev mode, no login was needed. CMS 5 is not affected. ### Reported by Jack Wallace

items.title: Next.js: Information disclosure across root params when a 'use cache' function is called through unstable_cache()
items.summary: Next.js applications with `'use cache'` can disclose cached data across root params when the same `'use cache'` function is called both directly during rendering and through `unstable_cache()`, and that function reads a root param.
